name: phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit gamma
pathways: positive regulation of MAP kinase activity

function.text: PIK3CG encodes phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit gamma isoform. Annotated molecular activities include 1-phosphatidylinositol-3-kinase activity and 1-phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase activity. It participates in positive regulation of MAP kinase activity and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.
